Job Summary

Experienced mobile technology leader responsible for the technical direction, engineering standards and delivery governance of the mobile banking platform across Android, iOS and Huawei/HarmonyOS ecosystems. The role owns the mobile platform architecture, quality, security, resilience and release readiness across multiple squads and markets, ensuring scalable, secure and maintainable mobile experiences for clients.

Key Responsibilities

  •    Own the technical direction, engineering standards and platform roadmap for the mobile banking application across Android, iOS and Huawei/HarmonyOS ecosystems.
  •    Ensure mobile solutions are secure, scalable, performant, accessible and resilient across supported devices, operating systems and app distribution channels.
  •    Partner with product, architecture, security and platform teams to sequence backlog items through a mobile engineering lens, balancing client impact, technical risk and platform sustainability.
  •    Govern mobile technical debt, including OS version support, device fragmentation, deprecated libraries, WebView compatibility, performance bottlenecks and maintainability risks.
  •    Review and approve solution intent for mobile platform changes, ensuring alignment with architecture standards, security controls and eSDLC requirements.
  •    Present mobile architecture decisions, platform standards and market-impacting changes to the architecture review forum.
  •    Drive mobile release readiness across markets, including app store dependencies, regression risk, environment readiness, observability, incident learnings and rollback considerations.
  •    Collaborate with Security Champions to identify and implement mobile security controls, including app hardening, secure storage, certificate pinning, biometric flows, RASP and jailbreak/root detection.

Business

  •    Develop and drive the mobile platform strategy and roadmap in collaboration with the Domain Tech Lead, architecture, security, product and market technology teams.

Processes

  •    Regularly review squad metrics for predictability, quality, delivery flow, mobile platform health and squad sentiment, and support teams to improve value delivery.
  •    Work with mobile engineering chapters to promote quality engineering, technical craftsmanship, reusable platform capabilities, consistent mobile standards and reduced duplication across markets.

People & Talent

  •    Contribute to technical innovation and share knowledge within the engineering community. 
  •    Stay updated on emerging technologies, lead internal workshops and seminars, encourage team participation in innovation initiatives

Governance

  •    Comply with System Delivery controls and attest for it with every (technical) release to production
  •    The controls cover: Requirements, Architecture (see Architecture Review Forum below), Security (see Cyber Security Services below), Development, Testing, IT Resilience, Service Level Management, Tech Operations & Support, Release Management, SW Configuration Management

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  •    Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct. 
  •    Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  •    Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

  •    Strong mobile engineering leadership experience across Android and iOS platforms, with working knowledge of Huawei/HarmonyOS ecosystem considerations.
  •    Experience with native mobile architectures, mobile platform governance, SDK integration, app lifecycle management and hybrid mobile/WebView patterns.
  •    Strong understanding of Android/Kotlin/Java, iOS/Swift, mobile build pipelines, app signing, certificates, app store release processes and mobile CI/CD.
  •    Experience managing mobile non-functional requirements, including performance, accessibility, security, observability, resilience, compatibility and supportability.
  •    Knowledge of secure mobile application design, including secure storage, biometric authentication, certificate pinning, app hardening, RASP and jailbreak/root detection.
  •    Understanding of API integration patterns for mobile applications, including REST/JSON, authentication, latency management, offline/error handling and network resilience.
  •    Experience leading engineering teams in Agile delivery, quality engineering, automated testing, DevOps and production release governance.

Qualifications

  • BSC in Computer Science or relevant certifications

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Be responsible for successful implementation of Premier Acquisition strategies
  • Acquire new-to-bank customers via central or self-generated leads.
  • In order to deliver a high quality service to our highest value personal clients the role holder will need to complete simple retail sales.
  • Development of strong working relationships with relevant business areas (e.g., WPB, Marketing, etc)
  • Delivery high standard customer service to meet customer satisfactory

  • 与相关业务领域建立牢固的工作关系（如：财富管理及个人银行业务部，市场部）
  • 提供高标准的客户服务，提高客户满意度

Qualifications - External

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of one year proven and progressive financial services and/or retail sales experience or equivalent
  • Sound knowledge of various forms of deposits, WEM product, mortgage, etc.
  • Knowledge of the constantly changing laws/regulations governing banks/finance industry, consumer trends, competitor offerings, economic and foreign currency markets
  • Strong presentation and sales skills
  • Objection handling techniques and work under pressure
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Customer service orientation
  • Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by market
  • Attain any internal standards as required by HBCN
  • 本科以上或同等学历
  • 至少一年金融服务或零售经验，或同等工作经验

  • 对行业法规，消费趋势，竞争对手的产品，经济和外汇市场趋势有较好的了解
  • 较好的演讲和销售技巧
  • 较好的异议处理技巧，能在高压下工作
  • 良好的人际交往和沟通能力
  • 以客户服务为导向

Job Summary

  • To ensure accurate calculation and posting entries in relation to valuation including management fee, expenses, performance fee…etc in accordance with Service Level Memorandum, and as appropriate the Fund Offering Memorandum and related documents such as fund’s SLM.
  • To ensure accurate capturing of trades / prices / Corporate Actions/ FX rates data and relevant accounting entries for the purpose of providing accurate Net Asset Value calculation.
  • Responsible for the daily maintenance of full accounting and client records of several investment funds books including general ledgers, cash positions, distribution records, investment records and pricing records of investments and support in fund administration related matters, such as recording and processing transactions, obtaining and verification of relevant documentation thereof and ensuring that investments are correctly recorded and priced, and accounted for Purchase and sale of listed or unlisted securities, Corporate Actions, Forward FX deals, OTC deals (Swaps, Options etc) and relevant accounting entries for the purpose of providing accurate Net Asset Value calculation.
  • Perform detailed review of the reports to CPC/clients including: Verification trades to relevant supporting, Ensure valuation of investments being checked to third party sources, Ensure appropriate accounting for complex investment, Ensure compliance with internal investment restrictions, external regulations and international accounting standards, if applicable. Identify issues and report to senior/supervisor with suggested solutions.
  • Responsible for fundamental cash monitoring for the assigned clients, i.e. monitoring cash positions of clients and prepare cash projection reports.
  • To be responsible for daily activities, cash & trade reconciliation.
  • Preparing Portfolio Valuations, investment compliance reports or other reporting, as required.
  • To calculate the Net Asset Value (on a daily, weekly, monthly or other basis as agreed) and deliver service / reports to CPC/clients in accordance with requirement and timeline as agreed in Services Level Memorandum.
  • To ensure proper and accurate calculation and posting of management fee, expenses, performance fee…etc in accordance with Service Level Memorandum, and as appropriate the Fund Offering Memorandum.
  • Recording and disbursing dividends either by payment or re-investment.
  • Calculating and disbursing payments of fees to the investment manager/advisor, custodian, administrator and other service providers as required.
  • To ensure fund administration services fees are settled by the client on timely manner.
  • Communicate with CPC and other relevant parties on daily operational issue (under appropriate supervision of Senior/Manager) and regular services review.
  • To ensure clear and smooth communication with Fund Accounting Team, Transfer Agency Team, Fund Compliance Team, Custody Team and other operations team for timely updating / maintenance of client records.
  • To support Assistant Manager/Manager/Senior Manager, handle and delivery assigned ad hoc project within the cutoff
  • Manage and avoid risks to clients, Bank/Group by ensuring prompt and accurate reporting to clients/management, timely rectification and /or monitoring of any discrepancies.
  • To provide accurate statistics relating to Key Risk Indicator (KRI) and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) to help measuring and meet division objectives.
  • To ensure all control/operating procedure and documentations are properly followed.
  • To ensure daily working volumes to be recorded accuracy and timely

  • Awareness and understanding of the Group's business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Awareness and understanding of the wider business, securities markets in which the FMO operates

Processes

  • Responsible for ensuring the accuracy of Net Asset Value of the fund in each valuation

People & Talent

  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values.

Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.

Risk Management

  • The ability to interpret the reconciliation breaks, prices fluctuations, ledger imbalances, valuation checking exception, identify key issues or potential risk based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures.

Governance

  • Responsible for complying to the group’s governance requirement, oversight and controls in the business

  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key Stakeholders

  • Onshore business partner
  • Client
  • Upstream teams ( GRU, CDMG, CS, Settlement, CA)

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in China / Fiduciary and Fund Services Team; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Support group’s operation transformation roadmap.

Skills And Experience

  • Accounting

  • Fund Operation

  • Languages: English, Mandarin

Strategy

  • The Bank is aiming to grow product capability through digital and self-direct channels. This Product Owner (PO) role is to drive the agile technology projects to establish a robust price discovery and execution platform. It is also required to build system interface with upstream systems (e.g. client information check) and downstream systems (e.g. booking trades into core banking platforms) to streamline operation flow and improve users (including clients) experience and frontline productivity.
  • As PO, you will develop and maintain a vision for agile technology projects and be responsible for communicating the vision to the scrum team. Be responsible for agile technology projects and features from concept to final implementation. In particular,
  • Have a good understanding of wealth management products, it's processes and relevance to clients.
  • Define and own the strategic digital product vision and roadmap for the wealth management product suite.
  • Align product strategy with business goals, market trends, and client needs.
  • Develop a competitive product strategy across relevant asset classes (such as FX, equities, fixed income, structured products, OTC derivatives, funds, and insurance.)
  • Monitor market dynamics and regulatory changes, ensuring products remain competitive and compliant.
  • As PO you will work with architects, business stakeholders and development teams to ensure that business, quality and functional goals are met with each release. Be responsible for the design, usability, quality and delivery of agile technology projects and features.
  • As the subject matter expert, this role is to determine business requirements, review technology project plans from the business perspective, and ensure new technology capabilities are embedded in business processes to deliver benefits. Ensure smooth execution on the ground, and communicate the changes delivered to relevant stakeholders including front office.

Business

  • Review and understand key business policies and processes in Wealth Management in offering CMPS products and services to both private banking and retail banking clients. Identify critical pain-points and articulate how planned / in-flight technology projects will solve them.
  • As Product Owner (PO), specialized in Digital platforms, should be familiar with the development of CMPS order management/ execution platforms and ensure that it is properly interfaced with multiple downstream booking systems.
  • The PO should have strong technical knowhow to improve front office systems performance and expand product penetration according to the business development.

Processes

  • The PO is the key decision maker on priorities and design decisions, and work to ensure that all stakeholders are aligned at each stage of the agile development lifecycle (when a new project is created). The PO also needs to understand both the engineering and business side of releases and be ultimately responsible for representing the end user’s needs.
  • Provide business input on requirements to the technology project teams. Work with subject-matter experts in product teams, front office and operations on requirements (e.g., a new electronic workflow to simplify layers of checking, or to auto-populate repeated fields in client forms). Prioritise “must have” items vs. “good to have”.
  • Review technology plans and design specifications, to ensure business requirements are met and that benefits will be delivered. Identify impact on critical processes within the Bank’s operational risk framework, and work with process owners and project teams to ensure robust controls.
  • Work with technology project teams to develop test plans. Co-ordinate business users to test new platforms or technology features that are developed. Ensure final delivery meets user needs.
  • Work with stakeholders in the front, middle and back offices to ensure successful “go live” of projects, from the business perspective. Develop training material, co-ordinate briefings, design and execute communication plans. Gather feedback post-implementation, and track benefits captured.
  • Participate in project review meetings and identify/highlight any potential issue that may impact project’s cost, timeline and/or scope and work with concerned stakeholders for its early resolution to bring back the project on track.
  • Conduct periodic briefings to senior management on progress of technology projects, from the business perspective. Highlight issues that require resolution.

People & Talent

  • Work towards strengthening the performance culture and reinforcement of accountabilities in products. Sharing the technical skills and experience with other team members.

Risk Management

  • Embed a risk culture that supports the Bank’s strategy and philosophy for the management of risk.
  • Ensure that effective arrangements are in place within WM in the region for the prevention of money laundering in line with the Group Policy and Standards, respective country regulatory guidelines and local legal requirements. In particular, ensure that the obligations on reporting suspicious activities are met.
  • Ensure that Risk Management matters that are brought to the job holder’s attention are subject to direct remedial action and/or ensure adequate reporting to the relevant Risk Committees

Governance

  • At all times have an awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Lead the business to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Regional and Country Wealth Management Heads and WM Product Managers.
  • Key markets Segment Heads, IAs and RMs
  • Market/Credit/Operational Risk, Legal, Compliance, Middle Office and COO team

Other Responsibilities

  • Perform other responsibilities assigned by Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
  • To achieve other business and non-financial objectives
  • To drive the Bank’s strategy and franchise development
  • To ensure that the business is conducted in an operationally robust environment
  • To ensure compliance with regulations and controls as set by the Bank and external regulatory authorities

Skills And Experience

  • Strong risk evaluation experience in Capital Markets / Wealth Management products
  • An ideal candidate should have 5 years of experience in technology & business
  • Extensive knowledge in financial market products

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5-8 years of experience in wealth management, investment banking, or financial services.
  • Good understanding of wealth management products and asset classes (example FX, equities, fixed income, structured products, OTC derivatives, funds, and insurance.)
  • Relevant knowledge of regulatory and operational frameworks in wealth management.
  • Preferred: Understanding of global wealth management market trends.
  • Relevant degree from reputable university
  • Project Management / System Development or equivalent
  • mandatory & developmental – role specific and regulatory/compliance bank wide specific
  • Proficient English

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Job Summary

Scope of Role:

To lead BDE team to achieve the team sales target by maximizing existing customers/acquisition/referral opportunities and providing quality customer service.

领导BDE团队开拓新客户，并通过提供优质客户服务进行交叉销售最终实现团队销售目标。

Key Responsibilities/Challenges

  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review
  • Properly perform the duties on management and ensure the effectiveness of internal control

  • 为内控失效造成的重大损失负责。

Strategy

  • Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates

Processes

  • Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.

People & Talent

  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.

  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
  • Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
  • Exercise authorities delegated by the Board of Directors and act in accordance with Articles of Association (or equivalent).

Skills And Experience

Qualifications

  • Good English speaking as well as in writing.
  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in a sales in a financial services.
  • Highly motivated and drove by number, strong interpersonal skills and demonstrate leadership attributes.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Proactively manage a complex portfolio of clients, becoming a trusted advisor to lead strategic dialogues with clients at a portfolio level through the understanding of specific business requirements and delivering creative and flexible customer solutions
  • To hand over customer relationship properly to their relationship managers after closing sales
  • To provide excellent services to customers and ensure all enquiries and complaints are accurately and effectively resolved to customers' satisfaction- To participate actively in team building activities to share information/ideas while contributing suggestions for work improvement- Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Strong interpersonal skills and effective presentation skills
  • Well-developed service and sales attitude with ability to work under pressure- Presentable, Outgoing and Persuasive- Good oral and written English is preferable

  • 主要负责中高端客户的开发，向潜在客户介绍汇丰的服务，发掘关于银行服务的需求并发展为汇丰客户

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Drive achievement against targets for revenue generation, product alignment, customer satisfaction and cost containment.

ln:4491113474.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

This role exists to ensure the accurate, timely and controlled execution of cash management activities across payment processing, clearing, client instructions, account maintenance and static data services. The role is responsible for delivering reliable operational outcomes that support client transactions, safeguard financial assets and maintain the integrity of the Bank's cash management services.

The role is accountable for processing and validating transactions, maintaining critical customer and product data, identifying and escalating operational exceptions, and ensuring service delivery aligns with agreed service levels, regulatory obligations and internal control standards. Through disciplined execution and strong operational risk management, the role contributes to client satisfaction, operational resilience and sustainable business growth.

Working closely with Operations teams, Service Delivery partners, Risk and Compliance functions, Technology teams and business stakeholders, the role helps convert operational requirements into consistent service outcomes. The role supports process efficiency, client experience and operational excellence but does not own product strategy, client relationship management or enterprise-wide operational policy.

Key Responsibilities

Service Delivery & Transaction Processing

  • Execute payment, clearing and cash management activities accurately and within agreed turnaround times to support uninterrupted client servicing.
  • Validate customer instructions, transaction data and processing requirements to ensure operational accuracy and minimise processing risk.
  • Resolve operational exceptions and processing breaks through timely investigation, escalation and corrective action.
  • Deliver service outcomes that consistently meet productivity, quality and client service standards.

Cash Management Operations & Data Integrity

  • Maintain customer, account and product static data to ensure completeness, accuracy and operational readiness across cash management services.
  • Apply established operational controls when performing account maintenance, pricing, billing and related operational activities.
  • Ensure transaction and client records are accurately captured and maintained to support operational, regulatory and audit requirements.
  • Identify data quality issues and drive corrective actions that improve operational effectiveness and minimise service disruptions.

Risk Management & Control Effectiveness

  • Apply operational risk controls that safeguard the Bank against transaction errors, operational losses and control breakdowns.
  • Conduct independent validation activities in accordance with segregation of duties, authority limits and control requirements.
  • Identify, assess and escalate operational risk events, control weaknesses and emerging risks through appropriate governance channels.
  • Support remediation activities that strengthen control effectiveness and reduce recurring operational issues.

Regulatory Compliance & Governance

  • Apply regulatory requirements, internal policies and operational procedures consistently across all cash management activities.
  • Perform AML, sanctions and other financial crime-related checks in line with Bank standards and escalation requirements.
  • Maintain accurate records and evidence that support audit reviews, governance reporting and regulatory inspections.
  • Promote adherence to conduct, compliance and risk standards that protect the Bank and its clients.

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve service quality and enhance operational efficiency across the end-to-end workflow.
  • Contribute to operational change initiatives, testing activities and business continuity readiness to support resilient service delivery.
  • Support the implementation of digitisation, automation and process enhancement initiatives that improve operational outcomes.
  • Share process insights and improvement opportunities to strengthen team effectiveness and service performance.

Stakeholder & Client Service Management

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve service issues and ensure effective delivery of cash management services.
  • Communicate operational issues, risks and service impacts clearly to relevant stakeholders to support timely resolution.
  • Build trusted working relationships that facilitate effective issue management and service improvements.
  • Support a client-focused culture by delivering responsive, accurate and professional operational services.

People and Talent

  • Build team capability through coaching, knowledge sharing and ongoing support that strengthens operational expertise and control awareness.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement while upholding the Bank's values and conduct expectations.
  • Support the development of colleagues through constructive feedback, training and opportunities to build operational competence.
  • Lead by example in demonstrating strong risk management, compliance discipline and service excellence.

Motivations

  • Motivated by delivering accurate and reliable operational outcomes in a high-volume, time-sensitive environment.
  • Energised by solving operational challenges, improving processes and enhancing service quality.
  • Thrives in environments that value collaboration, accountability, strong controls and continuous improvement.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Payment Processing
  • Cash Management
  • Certification and Accreditation
  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
  • Operations Management
  • Project Management
  • Service Delivery
  • Settlement Management

Other Skills

  • Transaction Management
  • Issue Management
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Service Recovery

Qualifications

  • Business English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking an experienced Vice President to lead our Private Markets Operations team. The team delivers high-quality, scalable administration, valuation, accounting and performance services to AO and AM clients across global markets. 

The successful candidate will bring strong people leadership, operational and risk judgment, client management and transformation capabilities. You will lead a large, multi-layer operations organization. You will also partner closely with global Product, Client Service, Technology and Operations teams to strengthen service delivery, drive transformation and build a sustainable future operating model. 

Why This Role Is Important to Us 

Our institutional clients depend on us for accurate, timely and transparent data across their private equity, private credit, real estate and infrastructure portfolios. This data feeds accounting, custody, performance, risk and client reporting, so its accuracy directly affects client decisions and trust. In this role, you will balance operational excellence day to day with long-term transformation. 

Key Responsabilities

Operations & Client Leadership 

Provide overall leadership and governance for private markets service delivery across multiple regions and service models. This includes document management, cash flow processing, valuation, commitment monitoring, look-through and performance reporting. 

Ensure consistent delivery against client SLAs, KPIs, risk and quality standards. 

Act as a senior escalation point for complex client and operational matters. 

Partner with Client Service and global stakeholders to resolve cross-functional issues and set clear accountability. 

Risk & Governance 

Maintain a strong operational risk and control environment, including procedures, reconciliations, exception management and root-cause remediation. 

Oversee service issues, incidents, controls, operational resilience, audit and compliance. 

Ensure transformation and operating-model changes keep appropriate controls and clearly defined ownership. 

Transformation & Operating Model 

Lead strategic transformation initiatives, including process redesign, automation, system migrations and operating-model changes. 

Drive standardization, automation and scalable solutions while balancing client needs, operational risk and efficiency. 

New Business & Growth 

Provide operational leadership for new client onboarding, due diligence, RFPs, client transitions and significant service expansions. 

Partner with Product, Client Service, Technology and Transition teams to deliver effective implementation and stabilization after go-live. 

Support the development of scalable service models aligned with long-term business growth. 

People & Organizational Leadership 

Lead and develop a multi-layer management organization, including AVPs and team leads, and build a strong leadership and succession pipeline. 

Build capabilities across private markets operations, data, technology, transformation and risk. 

Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement and constructive challenge. 

Qualifications & Experience  Required 

Bachelor's degree or above in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business or a related discipline. 

12+ years of relevant financial services experience, preferably in asset servicing, investment operations or fund administration. 

5+ years of senior people-management experience, including leading managers and large operational teams. 

Strong understanding of operational risk, controls, governance and service management. 

Demonstrated experience in transformation, technology implementation, migration or operating-model redesign. 

Proven ability to manage senior clients and global stakeholders across functions and regions. 

Excellent communication, influencing, problem-solving and decision-making skills. 

Fluent in English and Mandarin. 

Preferred 

Knowledge of private equity, private credit, infrastructure, real assets and other alternative investments. 

Experience supporting institutional investors such as pension funds, sovereign wealth funds or other large institutional investors. 

Professional qualifications such as CFA, CAIA, CPA or ACCA are preferred but not required. 

Leadership Profile 

The successful candidate will: 

Think enterprise-wide and take ownership beyond organizational boundaries. 

Create clarity and accountability in complex or ambiguous situations. 

Balance client needs, operational risk, cost and scalability. 

Influence Product, Technology and senior stakeholders through strong operational judgment. 

Build leaders and sustainable organizational capabilities. 

Stay close enough to operations to spot emerging risks, while focusing leadership attention on structural solutions and long-term outcomes. 

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
